The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Puts the heading first, then a stat strip, then cards, with figures from one formatter
- Pairs the green or red change colour with an arrow, sign or word and a spoken label
- Uses tabular figures, theme tokens and no raw numbers, and checks 360 and 900 px, light and dark, and 200 percent text

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
